metadata.title: ML-Assisted PC-SAFT for Pure-Component VLE of Hydrocarbons
metadata.interpretation: Errors are against published-parameter PC-SAFT, not experimental measurements.
metadata.temperature_basis: T/Tc from the published reference parameterization

experiments.note: All CV values use the original training pool, with three fixed folds. Collisions use the same 155 training SMILES. No test targets were used to select models.

dataset_profile.note: Entire 194-molecule curated collection; input descriptors only, no test target labels used in chart
